notes.title: Splash Cars Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi drivers, [/b]

We bring you a much needed update.

Fixes:
- unlocking the endless map
- unlocking "Winter Is Coming!" achievement

Improvements:
- engine optimizations
- polished some GUI elements
- added support for Apple Silicon

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Colourful game
notes.content:
[h2]Hi folks! :) [/h2]

[h3]February 2021 Update:[/h3]

We are working on level balancing right now. It looks like, we will keep 25 levels. Plus one more endless level after you beat all the previous 25 levels. This combo should provide at least two-hour gameplay for everyone!

Also playing with graphic design. Trying to make even more colorful ːsteamhappyː

And what now? Make a multiplayer or not? Online? Local? Split-screen? 2 players? 8 players? ːsteammockingː
The term "local co-op" refers to local multiplayer games played in a cooperative manner on the same system; these may use split-screen or some other display method.

We will see in the next update!

If you have some ideas and want to discuss them. 
Join our Discord on:
http://discord.paperbunker.cz

Have a nice day,
Paper Bunker
